intro: Georgia is a parliamentary republic. Debate over ties with Europe and Russia dominates its politics.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament elects the prime minister, who leads the government. The president is mainly ceremonial and, since 2024, is chosen by an electoral college.

chapters.title: East or West
text: Most Georgians support joining the EU and NATO. The Georgian Dream party has governed since 2012, and critics accuse it of moving closer to Russia, leading to mass protests.

keyTerms.meaning: A group of people chosen to elect someone.

cardGroups.title: How power works
cardGroups.intro: Who chooses whom, and what each part of the system does.

steps.title: How a law is made
steps.intro: Most new laws follow these steps.

items.title: A bill is proposed
items.text: By the government, members or 25,000 voters.

items.title: The President
items.text: Signs it or returns it with comments.
